description: Block destructive git and shell commands, and tool calls that would leak a secret into Claude's context; create or complete the repo's .harness.json with every setting off; generate the Git hooks .harness.json lists and install its status line; after a session where sessionReview is on (by default, where .about/ exists), review it with the glossary and adr skills

hooks.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/harness-config.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git-hooks.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/status-line.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-review.ts"; fi
